record.question: Who has become the first Indian man to win a Wushu World Championships gold in Shanghai in men's 48 kg Sanda?
record.explanation: Answer C: Praveen Kumar. Praveen Kumar won the men’s 48 kg Sanda final at the 2019 World Wushu Championships. The Sports Authority of India’s contemporaneous congratulatory post calls him India’s first men’s world champion; a contemporary report supplies the bout/category details. Reference: https://twitter.com/Media_SAI/status/1186990536607780864; https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/sport-others/praveen-kumar-first-indian-man-wushu-world-champion-6084114/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
